svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Containers and Docker, slide 2. A container is a standard box
svg.desc: A container is a standard box holding your code, the Node.js 24 runtime, the libraries and the settings; Docker packs it once and the same box runs on your laptop, a cloud VM or any Linux server.
svg.text: A container is a standard box
Your app and everything it needs, packed once. The same box runs the same way everywhere.
Docker packs, ships and runs these boxes.
